title: 1% Battery Made Him Rich
description:
Marlo's phone died at 1%. Every shop on the street said no charging. So he dragged out his old bike.

Watch how one dead phone turned into a million-dollar idea, the heatwave that nearly ruined it, and why MegaSock's robot tower couldn't compete.

New Marble Street story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next business.

Marble Street is an animated series about creative business ideas. Marlo, his street and every event are fictional. Made with AI tools (animation and voice).
